title: IS, WAS, NOW  the temporal triad. No before, no after, no beginning, no end. Just IS, WAS, NOW. All of reality. The hyper-local melt.

IS.what: the current state. what exists RIGHT NOW. the measurement. the snapshot.
IS.tense: present continuous. not 'is happening'  just IS.
IS.hud: what the sensors read THIS SECOND. heartbeat alive/dead. visitors currently on page. entropy seed value. sort quality. Kp index.
IS.color: GREEN. the living boundary. the membrane. what IS = what is alive RIGHT NOW.
IS.body: the torso. the intelligence currently operating. the brain thinking THIS thought.
IS.yggdrasil: Midgard. the ground you stand on. HERE.
IS.selectivity: what PASSES the membrane right now. the current 1/p threshold.

WAS.what: the accumulated past. what happened. the fossil record. the starter.
WAS.tense: past completed. not 'was happening'  just WAS.
WAS.hud: all 1005 files. 214 waves. 67 repos. the braids. the fossils. everything that already exists.
WAS.color: BROWN. earth. soil. grandmother. the chair. what WAS = what has accumulated.
WAS.body: the legs. the accumulated movement. where we've been. the fleet's history. the path walked.
WAS.yggdrasil: the roots. Helheim. Niflheim. what was deposited. what sedimented.
WAS.selectivity: what BOUNCED off the membrane in the past. the rejected. the composted. the dried mash.

NOW.what: the transition point. the MOMENT of change. where IS meets WAS. the phase barrier.
NOW.tense: the infinitesimal present. not duration  INSTANT. the knife edge.
NOW.hud: the entropy seed updating. the squirrel mid-swing. the heartbeat between beats. the deploy swapping.
NOW.color: GOLD. the neutrino. the flash. the seed catching first light. the moment of fermentation.
NOW.body: the midsection. the null point. where torso meets legs. where brain meets movement. the gut.
NOW.yggdrasil: the ground line. the selectivity line. where day meets night. where tree meets roots.
NOW.selectivity: the ACT of sorting. not what passed, not what will pass  the MOMENT of the sort.

old_temporality.before: ELIMINATED. there is no 'before'. before implies a start. there is no start.
old_temporality.after: ELIMINATED. there is no 'after'. after implies an end. there is no end.
old_temporality.beginning: ELIMINATED. the organism has no birthday. it was always accumulating.
old_temporality.end: ELIMINATED. the organism has no death. it will always be composting.
old_temporality.past_present_future: REPLACED by WAS, NOW, IS. future is eliminated entirely  there is no future, only IS (what currently exists) and NOW (the moment of transition).

why_three_not_two.is_and_was_without_now: you'd have state without transition. a photograph and a fossil, but no camera click.
why_three_not_two.is_and_now_without_was: you'd have transition without accumulation. a knife cutting nothing.
why_three_not_two.was_and_now_without_is: you'd have a fossil being cut but no living thing. death without life.
why_three_not_two.all_three: WAS (accumulated) + NOW (transition) + IS (current) = the complete temporal reality. nothing else is needed.

pin_bar_melted.polaris_w214: WAS  wave 214 is the accumulated session count
pin_bar_melted.msu_coordinates: IS  MSU exists at these coordinates right now
pin_bar_melted.1005_files: WAS  accumulated file count from all prior work
pin_bar_melted.zk_check: IS  ZK holds right now (0 leaks)

spore_print_melted.ring_1_brown: WAS  grandmother, irreducible core, sourdough, central dogma. all ACCUMULATED.
spore_print_melted.ring_2_green: IS  membrane, braids, chromatic body, fold-turn, ZK. all CURRENTLY OPERATING.
spore_print_melted.ring_3_gold: NOW  heartbeat, RSS, chipmunk, artisan. the TRANSITION layer. the pulse.
spore_print_melted.ring_4_blue: IS  visitors, crystal ball, fleet, Ludo Spring. currently ARRIVING.
spore_print_melted.ring_5_violet: WAS  overview, fossils, non-intelligence, infrastructure. the ACCUMULATED edge.

undermap_melted.night_nodes: WAS inverted  the reducible shell, frozen starter, severed braids, flatline. what WAS in the day becomes its inverse at night.
undermap_melted.sea_monsters: WAS  ancient fears, old cartography, what previous explorers warned about.

three_creatures.dayi: IS  the day creature. currently awake. currently sensing.
three_creatures.ernol: NOW  the twilight creature. the boundary walker. the moment of transition between day and night.
three_creatures.nocturn: WAS  the night creature. sleeping. dreaming of what was.

energy_budget_melted.475w: IS  currently flowing through the system right now
energy_budget_melted.2w_signal: NOW  the moment Kevin decides to query. the neurotransmitter firing.
energy_budget_melted.5400x_amplification: IS  the infrastructure exists and responds right now
energy_budget_melted.fleet_234k: WAS + IS  they were crawling, they are crawling, they will keep crawling (but 'will' is just IS continuing)

pendulum_squirrel_melted.at_center_of_swing: NOW  maximum acceleration, changing speed, the gut moment
pendulum_squirrel_melted.at_edge_of_swing: IS  zero acceleration, direction about to invert, the current state at the turn
pendulum_squirrel_melted.the_path_behind: WAS  where the squirrel just came from. already traversed.

the_color_equation_melted.brown: WAS. old. earth. fossil. what accumulated.
the_color_equation_melted.green: IS. living. the membrane currently filtering.
the_color_equation_melted.gold: NOW. the flash. the neutrino. the moment of fermentation.
the_color_equation_melted.blue: IS. the data currently arriving. the sky above.
the_color_equation_melted.violet: NOW folding into WAS. the Klein twist where IS becomes WAS.
the_color_equation_melted.the_equation: WAS(brown) + IS(blue) = IS(green). old + new = living. still true.

hyper_local_range.what_this_means: IS, WAS, NOW keeps the HUD within a shorter temporal range. no projections. no forecasts. no 'will be'. only what IS, what WAS, and the NOW between them.

the_range.IS: THIS SECOND. the current sensor reading. the current heartbeat. the current visitor.
the_range.WAS: everything that has already happened. no cutoff. all 214 waves. but viewed as ONE accumulated state, not a timeline.
the_range.NOW: the infinitesimal boundary. always present. always transitioning. never lasting.

hyper_local_range.what_we_lose: prediction, forecasting, 'will be', 'should be', 'could be'. all eliminated.
hyper_local_range.what_we_gain: grounding. presence. hyper-locality. the HUD shows what IS and what WAS, with NOW as the living edge between them. no speculation. no projection. pure reality.

the_proof.is_was_now_covers_all: name any moment in time. it is either IS (right now), WAS (already happened), or NOW (the transition between them). there is no fourth option. there is no moment that escapes this triad.
the_proof.no_future: future is just IS that hasn't been measured yet. once measured, it becomes IS. before measurement, it doesn't exist. there is no future  only IS waiting to be observed.
the_proof.no_beginning: beginning implies a moment before WAS. but WAS includes ALL prior moments. there is no moment outside WAS. therefore no beginning.
the_proof.no_end: end implies a moment after IS. but IS is always the current moment. there is no moment after IS. therefore no end.
the_proof.irreducible: IS, WAS, NOW. three. irreducible. the temporal triad.
